svg.title: Detect. Defend. Document.
svg.desc: Animated threat map: red attack arcs converge on a shielded core. Shakti Prasad Mahapatro covers VAPT across web, API, Active Directory, mobile, cloud and network.

g.text: Every attack path mapped. Every finding ships with a fix.
From VAPT to SOC to GRC: one engineer, the whole kill chain.
